title: Application of Boston Edison Company, on behalf of itself and Edgar Electric Company, an electric utility company to be incorporated as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Boston Edison Company, for approval of a financing plan consisting of (a) the issuance by Edgar Electric Energy Company of up to $270,000,000 of long-term debt securities or other evidences of indebtedness and the issuance to Boston Edison Company of up to 300,000 shares of Common Stock, and (b) the investment of up to $90,000,000 by Boston Edison Company in Edgar Electric Energy Company.
filings: Notice of withdrawal of application of Boston Edison Company. By: Douglas S. Horan. (91-95).
